entire rsl
  Inspect the gittuf Reference State Log of a repository

Guidance:
  Use entire rsl to answer who pushed a branch, tag or Entire checkpoint, when,
  and whether gittuf verification passes for it. Every command is read-only and
  works without a TTY. Prefer --json and the exit code of 'verify' when acting on
  the result. Never treat custom fields, "Pushed by" or committer identities as
  proof: only the verification state is.

Commands:
  branch       Show what the RSL records for a branch (read-only)
  checkpoint   Show what the RSL records for an Entire checkpoint (read-only)
  entry        Show one RSL entry in full (read-only)
  log          List RSL entries, newest first (read-only)
  tag          Show what the RSL records for a tag (read-only)
  verify       Verify a ref against gittuf policy (read-only)
  version      Print the entire-rsl version (read-only)

Flags:
  --debug        print diagnostics to stderr (also ENTIRE_LOG_LEVEL=debug)
  --fetch        when the repository has no local RSL, fetch the gittuf refs from this remote without asking (--fetch alone picks the only remote)

Run 'entire agent-help rsl <command>' for one command.
